### Michael Battles Satan
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/michael-battles-satan
Passage: Revelation 12:7-12
Points:
- The heavenly battle depicts the decisive defeat Satan suffered through Christ's life, death, and resurrection.
- Because Jesus atoned for sin, Satan's legal accusations against believers have been permanently silenced.
- Believers overcome the enemy through Christ's finished work and by remaining faithful to their gospel testimony.
- Believers must recognize that unseen spiritual warfare is real and prepare to stand firm through suffering.

### Forget about Being Worthy
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-may-19-2022.html
Passage: Revelation 12:11
Points:
- Believers cannot approach God based on personal worthiness or spiritual performance.
- Direct access to God and answered prayer rest solely on the shed blood of Jesus.
- Spiritual power and victory over the enemy are found at the cross rather than in good deeds.
- Trusting Christ's sacrifice frees Christians from guilt and works-righteousness.
